findings.first_evidence: device/lira/dictation_tools.py:11:  'pending不是成功，不可用pause_agent_task代替电视暂停。写好了或下一词用confirm，重播用replay，上一词用previous，结束用cancel。手动模式每次只播报一遍，等待用户控制，不自行重播或推进。')
findings.suggested_fix: 把新增的上一词/上一个和下一词请求纳入可信输入分类：上一词作为非提问控制请求处理；下一词与下一个一样设置 child_ack。增加 observe_user 后成功 previous 再提问暂停并恢复的回归用例，确保不会残留 question/answer_pending。
findings.title: 上一词请求被误记为未回答的提问

findings.first_evidence: device/lira/llm/chinese_dictation_skill.md:15: 当绑定流程的 manual_navigation=true 时，四会词每次只播报一次，结束后保持当前词等待遥控操作：左键返回上一词并播放，右键下一词并播放，确认键重播当前词。首词左键重播首词，末词右键结束；不循环、不计时重播或自动跳词。模型不能自行推进；收到孩子明确“下一个／写好了”才调用确认下一项，重播或上一词也须有对应请求。认读仍用确认键翻页；暂停后的确认键恢复当前词，不能绕过提问解释的暂停与继续确认。
findings.suggested_fix: Add the bound task's pinned playback settings, including manual_navigation, to model_instructions and the dialogue agent's system context; include the same setting in get_dictation_task_status so the agent can refresh it after adoption. Read from the task snapshot, not the latest configuration revision.
findings.title: Expose the bound manual mode to the agent

residual_risks: Live Doubao request/stream compatibility and actual Vivi prosody were not verified: this bounded review intentionally made no network or real-model calls.
testing_gaps: Cloud privacy coverage checks only an initially denied request. Add a mocked streaming response that flips allowed to false after its first audio row and assert synthesis aborts without returning or publishing PCM; this exercises the new per-row and post-stream privacy guards.
Cloud TTS tests cover incomplete PCM and a non-success code, but do not assert sanitized failures for malformed JSON, invalid base64, non-object rows, or an HTTP failure.
No focused test asserts that a manual task is rejected before asset upload when the TV omits dictation_manual_navigation_v1, or that an older non-manual task still delivers to that TV.
The native manual navigation test does not exercise the new previous command against explanation-audio-busy or expired-lease gates; existing V2 tests cover those gates only for earlier actions.
No targeted test covers a spoken next-word request arriving during manual-mode playback and the subsequent confirm call.
No focused compatibility test sends an older v2 task without manual_navigation to the updated TV and verifies it retains the original confirm/left/right behavior.
No focused transport test verifies that a manual_navigation task is rejected before asset upload when the TV lacks dictation_manual_navigation_v1.
Cloud tests cover privacy enabled before request, but not privacy activation while streaming followed by rejection without task publication.
